_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: National Voluntary Laboratory Accreditation Program (NVLAP) Assessment Reports
summary: The National Voluntary Laboratory Accreditation Program (NVLAP) Assessment Reports and accompanying documentation will be used by the Government to develop the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program (NNPP) Management System.
use_relationship:
The National Voluntary Laboratory Accreditation Program (NVLAP) Assessments Reports and accompanying documentation will be used by the Government to develop the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program (NNPP) Management System. A Management System is required in order to comply with the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 17025 Section 8.
This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to dosimetry contracts that require Assessment Reports prior to delivery. This DID is consistent with ISO 17025 as this document contains the requirements for National Voluntary Laboratory Accreditation Program (NVLAP) accreditation.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the discrete Contract Line items as delineated in the contract Statement of Work.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.
